newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPI to focus on Angola, Mozambique.
newsitem.headline: BPI to focus on Angola, Mozambique.

text.p: Banco Portugues de Investimento will seek business opportunities in the former Portuguese colonies of Angola and Mozambique, BPI president Artur Santos Silva said.
He said the group had requested authorisation from the government of Mozambique to convert its branch there into a bank that would have equal status to a Mozambican bank.
"We consider Mozambique and Angola to be countries where we can reinforce our presence abroad," Santos Silva said. "Our immediate priority will be these two countries," he added.
Santos Silva, speaking after the presentation of the bank's 1996 results on Wednesday, also said BPI could invest in the West African island state of Cape Verde.
The BPI group already operates two offices in Mozambique, including one which provides support to the corporate sector. It plans to open offices this year in Beira and Nampula.
The BPI group has no offices in Angola.
